results.title: Unibox Alternative | Talanoa
results.content:
Unibox has been discontinued and is no longer available.

Unibox pioneered a people-centric inbox on macOS — a fresh take that grouped emails by sender instead of time, offering a chat-like interface that felt natural and human. It was ahead of its time.

Talanoa continues that spirit with a modern, actively developed app that’s fast, privacy-first, and built for today’s email workflows. If you loved Unibox, you’ll feel right at home with Talanoa.

## What Made Unibox Special

Unibox introduced a revolutionary approach to email on Mac: [...] | Feature | Unibox | Talanoa |
 --- 
| 🧠 UX Philosophy | People-centric, grouped by sender | People-first with Teammates/People/Notifications sections |
| 📬 Inbox Organization | Contact list sidebar, chronological messages | Smart categorization + Kanban workflow for task management |
| 💬 Message View | Chat-like interface, SMS style | Conversation threads with context and clarity |
| 📎 Attachments | Icon grid + list view per contact | Searchable attachments grouped by sender |
| 🧵 Thread Handling | Drill-down thread view for conversations | Native conversation threading with participants |
| ✍️ Composer | Single-window inline compose | Focused, distraction-free compose with quick access | [...] Contact-centric design: A clean contact list on the left, sorted by most recent email
 Chat-like conversations: All messages with a person in one chronological list, like SMS apps
 Beautiful attachment views: Grid-based icon view with previews and detailed list view
 Single window workflow: Read and compose in the same window without losing context
 Clean interface: Each person displayed only once, no clutter

Talanoa builds on these foundations while adding modern productivity features.

results.title: Spike Alternative Without the Chat Bubble Format | Talanoa
results.content:
# 🆚 Spike vs Talanoa

Email reimagined — two very different ways.

Spike turns email into a chat interface: no headers, no quoted text, just bubbles. It’s fast and modern. But the chat metaphor strips away context that matters — especially in professional settings. Talanoa reimagines email around people too, but keeps the depth and clarity that serious communication requires. [...] ### 3. People Without the Chat Metaphor

Both Spike and Talanoa organize email around people. But Spike does it by making email look like iMessage. Talanoa does it by surfacing your most important contacts front and center — without forcing a visual metaphor that breaks down in professional or formal contexts.

### 4. Privacy by Architecture, Not Just Protocol

Spike uses standard TLS/SSL — the same security as any email server. That’s fine, but it means your email data lives on their infrastructure. Talanoa stores everything locally on your device. No servers. No data sharing. No breach risk from a third-party service you rely on.

### 5. Kanban Instead of AI Feed [...] | Feature | Spike | Talanoa |
 --- 
| 🧠 UX Philosophy | Email as a messaging app (chat bubbles) | People-first, relationship-driven |
| 📝 Email Organization | Conversational threading, no headers | Kanban board + sender-based sections |
| 📬 Email Providers | Gmail, Outlook, IMAP/POP3 | Gmail, Outlook (more coming) |
| 💻 Platform | iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, Web | Desktop (Mac/Windows), mobile soon |
| 🤖 AI Features | AI Feed (bulk summary), AI responses | Planned: privacy-first local AI |
| 🔒 Privacy | TLS/SSL (standard) | 100% local — no servers, no data sharing |
| 👥 Collaboration | Teamspace with shared email channels | Built around individual clarity (teams coming soon) |
| 📌 Task Management | Notes + tasks add-on | Native Kanban productivity |
